repo.description: Git worktree path. Absolute path (backward compatible), or "." / "" to resolve via git rev-parse --show-toplevel from process cwd (hooks/worktrees). Env GIT_GUARD_REPO overrides config when set.

require_branch.description: Exact branch name required, or null to skip

require_clean.description: Fail if working tree / index is dirty

ignore_untracked.description: Untracked path globs ignored when require_clean is true

forbid_staged.description: Fail if any staged files exist

allow_path_globs.description: Every changed path must match at least one allow glob

deny_path_globs.description: Fail if any changed path matches a deny glob

base_ref.description: Diff working tree / staged against this ref for path checks

diff_refs.description: Review path set for a commit range against allow/deny

forbid_overlap_refs.description: Refs whose changed files must not overlap current diff

forbid_actions.description: Action types that always FAIL (e.g. force_push, reset_hard)

human_gate_actions.description: Action types that always NEED_HUMAN even if other checks pass

push_safety.description: When set to v2.1, normal push uses safe-push evaluation instead of unconditional human_gate on push

local_safety.description: When set to v2.2, --action local_git uses safe local operation evaluation (explicit guard invocation only)

required_tests.description: Commands run only when checks pass and --run-tests is set
